ModMetaData.name: Guns For All Post-Medieval Tech Levels
ModMetaData.author: Bambaryla, KylarZ, Haderoth, Samael Gray
ModMetaData.description:
Fills the weaponry gaps across tech levels.
Vanilla RimWorld has conventional (ballistic) weapons at industrial level and charge weapons at ultra/spacer level, leaving spacer-tier conventional weapons and industrial/spacer-tier charge weapons entirely absent.
This mod adds: - Industrial Charge: crude charge weapons built with industrial-era components (crude charge pistol, rifle, bullpup, DMR, shotgun, LMG, sniper) - Spacer Charge: refined charge weapons using spacer-grade steel components (spacer charge pistol, rifle, bullpup, DMR, shotgun, LMG, sniper) - Spacer Ballistic: advanced conventional weapons precision-machined from plasteel (advanced pistol, rifle, bullpup, DMR, shotgun, LMG, sniper rifle) - Ultra Ballistic: the pinnacle of conventional ballistic technology (precision pistol, rifle, bullpup, DMR, shotgun, LMG, sniper rifle)
With Combat Extended: - Industrial charge weapons don't exist and instead the vanilla charge-level is extended with the pistol, battle rifl, rifle, DMR, shotgun, LMG and sniper rifle. - Expandable launchers with tiers and damage types (e.g. industrial HE, spacer EMP)
With Beyond Our Reach: - Solar and Quasar level charge weapons (solar pistol, rifle, bullpup, DMR, shotgun, LMG, sniper) With BOR and CE: - Solar and Quasar level multi-fire expandable launchers
Each tier introduces two new weapon types not found in vanilla: - Bullpup: compact assault rifle with a four-shot burst - DMR (Designated Marksman Rifle): lighter and faster-aiming than a sniper rifle, at the cost of some damage and range
All weapons have custom research and crafting recipes, and are balanced to fit their respective tech levels.
Credits: - Textures by Haderoth - Initial design by Bambaryła - CE balancing by Bambaryła and Samael Gray
Inspirations: - Spacer and Ultra Conventional weapons: Mass Effect weapon designs - Industrial Charge weapons: real-life firearm designs - Spacer Charge weapons: Xenonauts laser weapon designs - Solar Charge weapons: Xenonauts plasma weapon designs - Quasar Charge weapons: Helldivers 2 weapon designs - Launchers: Star Wars, Helldivers 2, Killzone and real life designs.
